pages.title: The Sixteen Eyes
pages.text: $(bold)The End portal needs sixteen different eyes. None can be mined, crafted or found: each node on the last ring gives you its eye the moment you unlock it.$(br2)Every eye is a node on the last ring, $(thing)28 Focal Shards$(n) each, all behind the final seal.

pages.title: Boss by Boss
pages.text: $(bold)Each eye's task is a boss kill: Bosses' Rise, Cataclysm, Cult of Azazel or the Wither. Without that boss's mod, the node asks for other work instead.$(br2)A boss takes no damage from you until a node that asks for it is reachable, so you cannot waste a kill.

pages.title: Lost Eyes
pages.text: $(bold)Lost an eye? Kill its boss again while you own its node and carry none of that eye, and you are given another.
